mapper.select:
SELECT sm.match_id, sm.title, sm.facility_id, f.name AS facility_name, sm.sport_id, s.name AS sport_name, sm.start_at, sm.end_at, sm.max_participants, AS occupied_count, sm.status
JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = sm.created_by
ORDER BY sm.start_at, sm.match_id

SELECT sm.match_id, sm.title, sm.facility_id, f.name AS facility_name, sm.sport_id, s.name AS sport_name, sm.start_at, sm.end_at, sm.max_participants, AS occupied_count, sm.status
WHERE sm.match_id = #{matchId}

SELECT DISTINCT s.sport_id, s.name FROM facility_sport fs JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = fs.facility_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN facility_manager fm ON fm.facility_id = f.facility_id AND fm.user_id = #{managerUserId} JOIN sport s ON s.sport_id = fs.sport_id ORDER BY s.sport_id

SELECT ma.application_id, u.nickname AS applicant_name, ma.application_type, ma.status, ma.receipt_no, ma.created_at, c.club_name FROM match_application ma JOIN social_match sm ON sm.match_id = ma.match_id JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = sm.facility_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN facility_manager fm ON fm.facility_id = f.facility_id AND fm.user_id = #{managerUserId} JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = ma.applicant_user_id LEFT JOIN club c ON c.club_id = ma.club_id WHERE ma.match_id = #{matchId} ORDER BY ma.created_at, ma.application_id
